us.description: ABU DHABI: Hosts UAE concluded their 2026 Jiu-Jitsu World Championship campaign on Sunday by claiming the Adult and U-21 Newaza titles after nine days of competition at Mubadala Arena. More than 1,500 athletes from around the world competed across different age groups and disciplines in Abu Dhabi, with the UAE winning 65 medals, including 18 gold, 17 silver and 30 bronze. The Adult team produced one of the standout results of the championship. Along with winning the Newaza world title, the UAE finished top of the overall Adult standings across all disciplines despite competing only in Newaza. The overall standings included results from Contact Jiu-Jitsu, Fighting, Duo and Show. The U-21 Team added a second world title for the hosts by finishing top of the Newaza competition, underlining the strength of the UAE’s next generation of athletes and their progression toward the senior national team.

gb.title: Jose Mourinho issues retirement update as new Real Madrid boss aims dig at Pep Guardiola
gb.description: Jose Mourinho has insisted retirement remains firmly off his agenda and suggested he could continue managing into his 70s - while appearing to aim a thinly-veiled dig at long-time rival Pep Guardiola. The 63-year-old returned to Real Madrid this summer for a sensational second spell in charge and has committed his future to the Spanish giants by signing a three-year contract. But Mourinho is already looking considerably further ahead and has revealed he can envisage spending at least another decade in management. Speaking in his new three-part Netflix documentary, MOURINHO, the Portuguese coach admitted the prospect of walking away from football is almost impossible for him to contemplate. TRENDING Stories Videos Your Say "I cannot even imagine when I am going to stop my life in football," Mourinho said. "I say 10 more years, but maybe more than 10. It's fun. It was, it is and will always be fun. "I want to win more titles. I want to win new titles. I want to repeat titles. "I want to do it in places where I have never been. I want to do it in places where I did before." Mourinho has been working as a manager for more than a quarter of a century after taking his first senior job with Benfica in 2000. His remarkable career has subsequently taken him across Europe, including spells with Porto, Chelsea, Inter Milan, Real Madrid, Manchester United, Tottenham, Roma and Fenerbahce. Yet Mourinho believes the thrill of operating inside packed stadiums remains as powerful as ever. "My world is to walk in a football stadium with 50,000 or 90,000 [fans]. I had 100,000. That is my world," he added. LATEST SPORTS NEWS: Football star falls down huge tunnel celebrating goal before VAR delivers brutal twist George Russell engaged as F1 star proposes to girlfriend Carmen Montero Mundt after six years Jose Mourinho makes female doctor claim as he revisits explosive Chelsea controversy after 11 years "Without football, there is not something complete in me. "But I don't think it is an obsession. I don't feel it as an obsession. "It is just when you reach a certain level, you want to stay there forever." Mourinho also used the documentary to make his feelings about managers taking extended breaks from football abundantly clear. And his comments could be interpreted as a dig at Guardiola, with whom Mourinho shared one of football's most combustible managerial rivalries during his first spell in Madrid. Guardiola stepped away from management for a year following his departure from Barcelona in 2012 before taking charge of Bayern Munich the following summer. Mourinho, however, insists a sabbatical has never appealed to him - and even described taking one as a sign of "weakness". "Some guys, they need a sabbatical - which is something that I hate. I hate that word," he said. "For me, sabbatical means weakness. Don't speak with me about sabbaticals. "I never need a rest. I will have a rest when he [Mourinho points to the sky] decides to say: 'Come up'." Mourinho and Guardiola regularly clashed during the Portuguese's first stint at Real Madrid between 2010 and 2013, when their rivalry helped fuel a particularly bitter period of Clasico encounters. es.title: España conquista el Eurbasket Sub-18 femenino
es.description: La selección española femenina Sub-18 de baloncesto conquistó este domingo su segundo Campeonato de Europa consecutivo tras superar con autoridad y brillantez (46-82) a la de Francia en la final del torneo celebrada en Kista, Estocolmo (Suecia). Después del título el verano pasado en La Palma, la Sub-18 femenina española encarriló su séptimo título desde un 24-7 en el primer cuarto y defendió su reinado en la categoría con una exhibición liderada por la MVP del torneo Somto Okafor (17 puntos y 15 de valoración), María Carbo (12 y 17), Shaila Nde y Ada Toribio. La presidenta de la Federación Española de Baloncesto (FEB), Elisa Aguilar, se desplazó a Estocolmo para vivir la final ante Francia y apoyar el equipo dirigido por Isaac Fernández. "Supone un hito para nuestro baloncesto. Estas chicas han dado forma a un equipo especial y han conseguido, por primera vez en nuestra historia, revalidar el título en una categoría especialmente difícil", dijo en declaraciones facilitadas por la FEB. "El equipo que dirige Isaac Fernández ha realizado un campeonato increíble, con un juego espectacular y nos ha hecho disfrutar del primer al último minuto. Hay que dar la enhorabuena a todas las campeonas porque han demostrado que tiene un presente y un futuro brillante", añadió. Por otro lado, Elisa Aguilar valoró otro exitoso verano de la cantera del baloncesto español. "Este oro es la cuarta medalla del verano y estamos orgullosos de todas las selecciones que han competido y están compitiendo. También hemos conseguido clasificarnos, de momento, para dos Copas del Mundo y podemos decir que el verano está siendo un éxito. Ahora nos queda apoyar y disfrutar con nuestras selecciones Sub 16 para que consigan los objetivos en el Eurobasket", apuntó.

sg.title: Porsche Builds a One-Off 911 Turbo S "Land Down Under" to Celebrate 75 Years in Australia
sg.description: Summary Porsche Cars Australia and the Sonderwunsch department have created a one-off 911 Turbo S titled "Land Down Under" to commemorate the brand's 75th anniversary in AustraliaThe vehicle features a bespoke two-tone Chromaflair exterior that transitions from Terra Australis Red to Southern Cross Blue in a process that required more than 300 hours of hand-applied craftsmanshipUnique details include a "See ya later mate" message hidden under the active rear spoiler and an interior headliner embroidered with the southern night sky as it appeared over Uluru in 1951 Porsche has officially rolled out the automotive equivalent of a love letter to the Australian outback. Commemorating 75 years of the brand's presence in the country, the regional division teamed up with the in-house Sonderwunsch customization department to create the one-off 911 Turbo S "Land Down Under." The celebratory vehicle represents a deep appreciation for the expansive landscapes and dramatic contrasts that define the Southern Hemisphere. Unveiled during a high-profile Sydney debut, the exclusive release merges top-tier German engineering with a heavy dose of cultural iconography.The undeniable centerpiece of the commemorative sports car is its painstaking exterior finish. Inspired by a deep outback sunset, the bespoke two-tone Chromaflair paint scheme transitions seamlessly from a dusty Terra Australis Red at the lower half into a sprawling Southern Cross Blue across the shoulderline. Formulated specifically for this project, the highly exclusive pigment incorporates reflective aluminum flakes encased in a transparent layer. This allows the exterior to shift colors between desert orange, dusk-sky blue, eucalyptus green and sunrise gold depending on the viewing angle. The breathtaking gradient required more than 300 hours of manual craftsmanship to complete. The automaker even color-matched the 20- and 21-inch Turbo Exclusive wheels in the custom blue hue.Adding localized flair, the brand tapped contemporary artist Werner Bronkhorst to integrate subtle storytelling elements across the bodywork. A ghosted "75" graphic marks the roof while miniature motifs and native fauna are dotted discreetly around the exterior. The most cheeky addition hides beneath the active rear spoiler, which deploys to reveal the message "See ya later mate" as a fitting farewell for anyone trying to keep pace with the vehicle's blistering 322-km/h top speed.Inside the cabin, the rugged natural beauty of the continent continues to dictate the design language. The 18-way sports seats are upholstered in a unique Coolibah Brown leather with white centers and feature over 14,000 individual perforations styled to resemble organic brushstrokes. Dark Night Blue and Neodyme accents frame the interior alongside a custom steering wheel boasting a Kalahari 12 o'clock marker. Hand-finished Australian Silky Oak wood inlays line the dashboard, which also showcases an engraved topographical map of the Blue Mountains. Looking up, passengers are treated to a headliner intricately embroidered with the Southern Hemisphere constellation map that displays the exact night sky as it appeared over Uluru when Porsche first arrived in Australia in 1951.Beneath the custom aesthetics, the coupe remains a mechanical powerhouse. The car is driven by a 3.6-liter flat-six engine bolstered by dual eTurbos and 400V hybrid technology, pushing 523kW of power to all four wheels via an eight-speed dual-clutch transmission. Following a nationwide tour to showcase the anniversary celebration, the irreplaceable one-off is expected to be preserved permanently within the heritage fleet rather than heading to a public auction. sg.title: The Dallas Mavericks Are Offering 32 Years of Season Tickets for This 1-of-1 Cooper Flagg Card
sg.description: Summary The Dallas Mavericks have publicly offered a trade package to whoever pulls Cooper Flagg's one-of-one debut patch autograph cardThe bounty is built like a real NBA trade, bundling season tickets, memorabilia and VIP experiences into a single offerThe 1-of-1 Topps card carries a game-worn patch from Flagg's first NBA game and could sell for millions The Dallas Mavericks want Cooper Flagg's one-of-one debut patch autograph card badly enough to structure the pitch like a front-office trade. On Thursday, as the card officially hit packs, the franchise announced a proposed deal aimed at whoever is lucky enough to pull the Topps 1-of-1, stacking the offer with perks a normal marketplace can't match.The centerpiece is time. The finder would land two premium lower-level season tickets for the next 32 years, a nod to Flagg's jersey number, alongside a signed, game-worn rookie jersey and a postgame photo with the forward. From there the package tips into full experience territory: a road trip to watch the Mavericks take on the Boston Celtics with airfare, hotel and game tickets covered, a private photo shoot with both the Rookie of the Year trophy Flagg won last season and the Larry O'Brien Trophy, and a VIP tour of the team's practice facility with a meet-and-greet. A "private basketball experience" for up to 10 guests at American Airlines Center closes out the seven-item haul.Dallas is playing it partly for laughs, with the fine print noting the offer is subject to a definitive written agreement and that "this is a proposed trade." The catch is that the card itself is the kind of asset that makes a fan think twice before accepting perks over a payday.Flagg signed the piece at the third annual Fanatics Fest last month, and he admitted the moment got to him. "I want to do my best," he said, before advising whoever ends up with it to hold on because "it will gain value as I go through my career." That advice tracks with the projections. Geoff Wilson, founder of Sports Cards Investor, told ESPN that he expects the card could clear the $1.11 million USD that Paul Skenes' 1-of-1 rookie debut patch card fetched at auction last year, potentially reaching $1.5 million USD.There's precedent for exactly this standoff. When the Pittsburgh Pirates floated a comparable trade for the Skenes 1-of-1 in 2024, the 11-year-old collector who pulled it turned the offer down and sent the card to auction, where it set a record. With Flagg fresh off a season averaging 21 points, 6.7 rebounds and 4.5 assists and a 50-point game that made him the youngest to hit the mark in league history, his rookie card is positioned to write its own off-court record. id.title: Porsche Ciptakan 911 Turbo S "Land Down Under" One-Off untuk Rayakan 75 Tahun di Australia
id.description: Ringkasan Porsche Cars Australia dan divisi Sonderwunsch menghadirkan sebuah 911 Turbo S edisi satu-satunya bertajuk "Land Down Under" untuk menandai perayaan 75 tahun kehadiran brand tersebut di Australia.Mobil ini mengusung eksterior Chromaflair two-tone khusus yang bergradasi dari Terra Australis Red ke Southern Cross Blue, melalui proses pengerjaan tangan yang memakan waktu lebih dari 300 jam.Detail-detail uniknya mencakup pesan "See ya later mate" yang tersembunyi di bawah rear spoiler aktif, serta headliner interior yang disulam dengan motif langit malam di belahan selatan sebagaimana tampak di atas Uluru pada tahun 1951. Porsche resmi meluncurkan padanan otomotif dari surat cinta untuk pedalaman Australia. Untuk menandai 75 tahun kehadirannya di Australia, divisi regional Porsche berkolaborasi dengan departemen kustomisasi internal Sonderwunsch untuk menciptakan 911 Turbo S "Land Down Under" satu-satunya. Kendaraan perayaan ini menjadi wujud apresiasi mendalam terhadap lanskap luas dan kontras dramatis yang mendefinisikan belahan Bumi selatan. Diperkenalkan dalam peluncuran prestisius di Sydney, model eksklusif ini memadukan rekayasa Jerman kelas atas dengan sentuhan kuat ikonografi budaya Australia.Daya tarik utama mobil sport edisi peringatan ini terletak pada kelir eksteriornya yang dikerjakan dengan amat saksama. Terinspirasi matahari terbenam pekat di pedalaman Australia, skema cat dua warna Chromaflair yang dibuat khusus ini bertransisi mulus dari Terra Australis Red bernuansa berdebu di bagian bawah ke Southern Cross Blue yang membentang di sepanjang garis bahu. Diformulasikan khusus untuk proyek ini, pigmen yang sangat eksklusif tersebut memadukan serpihan aluminium reflektif dalam lapisan transparan. Efeknya, warna eksterior berubah-ubah antara oranye gurun, biru langit senja, hijau eukaliptus, dan emas fajar, bergantung pada sudut pandang. Gradasi menawan ini membutuhkan lebih dari 300 jam pengerjaan manual. Porsche bahkan menyelaraskan warna pelek Turbo Exclusive berukuran 20 dan 21 inci dengan rona biru kustom tersebut.Untuk menambah sentuhan lokal, Porsche menggandeng seniman kontemporer Werner Bronkhorst guna menghadirkan elemen naratif subtil di sekujur bodi. Grafis "75" samar membubuhkan aksen pada atap, sementara motif mungil dan fauna asli Australia tersebar secara halus di eksterior. Sentuhan paling jenaka tersembunyi di balik spoiler belakang aktif, yang akan terbuka untuk menampilkan pesan "Sampai jumpa nanti, kawan"—salam perpisahan yang pas bagi siapa pun yang berusaha mengimbangi kecepatan puncak mobil ini, 322 km/jam.Di dalam kabin, keindahan alam liar benua ini tetap menjadi acuan bahasa desainnya. Kursi sport dengan 18 pengaturan dibalut kulit Coolibah Brown yang unik, berbagian tengah putih, serta dihiasi lebih dari 14.000 perforasi individual yang dirancang menyerupai sapuan kuas organik. Aksen Dark Night Blue dan Neodyme membingkai interior, berdampingan dengan setir kustom berpenanda posisi pukul 12 berwarna Kalahari. Inlay kayu Australian Silky Oak yang diselesaikan dengan tangan menghiasi dasbor, yang juga menampilkan peta topografi Blue Mountains berukir. Saat memandang ke atas, penumpang akan disuguhi pelapis plafon yang disulam rumit dengan peta rasi bintang belahan Bumi selatan, menampilkan langit malam persis seperti yang terlihat di atas Uluru saat Porsche pertama kali tiba di Australia pada 1951.Di balik estetika kustomnya, coupe ini tetap merupakan pusat tenaga mekanis. Mobil ini ditenagai mesin flat-six 3,6 liter yang didukung dua eTurbo dan teknologi hibrida 400V, menyalurkan tenaga 523 kW ke keempat roda melalui transmisi kopling ganda delapan percepatan. Setelah menjalani tur keliling Australia untuk menampilkan perayaan hari jadi tersebut, unit satu-satunya yang tak tergantikan ini diperkirakan akan disimpan secara permanen dalam armada warisan Porsche, alih-alih dilelang kepada publik. id.title: Dallas Mavericks Tawarkan Tiket Musiman 32 Tahun untuk Kartu Cooper Flagg 1-of-1 Ini
id.description: Ringkasan Dallas Mavericks secara terbuka menawarkan paket trade kepada siapa pun yang berhasil menarik kartu one-of-one debut patch autograph milik Cooper Flagg.“Bounty” ini disusun layaknya trade resmi NBA, menggabungkan tiket musiman, memorabilia, dan berbagai pengalaman VIP dalam satu penawaran eksklusif.Kartu 1-of-1 Topps tersebut memuat patch game-worn dari pertandingan NBA perdana Flagg dan berpotensi terjual hingga jutaan dolar. Dallas Mavericks sangat menginginkan kartu debut patch bertanda tangan one-of-one milik Cooper Flagg hingga menyusun penawarannya layaknya pertukaran pemain di jajaran manajemen tim. Pada Kamis, saat kartu itu resmi beredar dalam kemasan, klub tersebut mengumumkan proposal penawaran bagi siapa pun yang beruntung mendapatkan kartu Topps 1-of-1 tersebut, dengan sederet keuntungan yang tak bisa ditandingi pasar biasa.Daya tarik utamanya adalah jangka waktunya. Penemu kartu itu akan memperoleh dua tiket musiman premium di area tribun bawah selama 32 tahun ke depan—merujuk nomor punggung Flagg—beserta jersey rookie bertanda tangan yang pernah dipakainya saat bertanding dan foto bersama sang forward setelah laga. Paket ini kemudian mengarah ke pengalaman yang lebih lengkap: perjalanan tandang untuk menyaksikan Mavericks menghadapi Boston Celtics, dengan tiket pesawat, hotel, dan tiket pertandingan ditanggung; sesi foto privat bersama Trofi Rookie of the Year yang diraih Flagg musim lalu serta Trofi Larry O'Brien; juga tur VIP ke fasilitas latihan tim dan sesi temu sapa. Pengalaman basket privat di American Airlines Center untuk maksimal 10 tamu melengkapi tujuh item dalam paket tersebut.Dallas tampaknya juga menjadikannya bahan gurauan, dengan catatan kecil yang menyebut penawaran ini bergantung pada perjanjian tertulis yang definitif dan bahwa “ini adalah pertukaran yang diusulkan”. Namun, kartu itu sendiri merupakan aset yang bisa membuat penggemar berpikir dua kali sebelum memilih berbagai keuntungan tersebut ketimbang uang tunai.Flagg menandatangani kartu tersebut di Fanatics Fest edisi ketiga bulan lalu, dan ia mengakui momen itu terasa sangat besar baginya. “Saya ingin memberikan yang terbaik,” ujarnya, sebelum menyarankan siapa pun yang akhirnya memegang kartu itu untuk menyimpannya karena “nilainya akan naik seiring perjalanan karier saya.” Saran itu sejalan dengan proyeksi pasar. Geoff Wilson, pendiri Sports Cards Investor, mengatakan kepada ESPN bahwa ia memperkirakan kartu ini bisa melampaui US$1,11 juta yang diraih kartu debut patch rookie 1-of-1 milik Paul Skenes di lelang tahun lalu, dan berpotensi menembus angka US$1,5 juta.Tarik-ulur seperti ini bukan tanpa preseden. Ketika Pittsburgh Pirates mengajukan penawaran serupa untuk kartu Skenes 1-of-1 pada 2024, kolektor berusia 11 tahun yang mendapatkan kartu itu menolaknya dan melelang kartu tersebut, yang kemudian mencetak rekor. Usai musim dengan rata-rata 21 poin, 6,7 rebound, dan 4,5 assist, serta laga 50 poin yang menjadikannya pemain termuda yang mencapai angka itu dalam sejarah liga, kartu rookie Flagg berpeluang mencetak rekornya sendiri di luar lapangan. th.description: เจ้าท่าเชียงราย ชี้ ‘น้ําโขง’ เริ่มทรงตัว-ลดลง หลังจีน-ลาวระดับน้ําลด ย้ํายังอยู่ในช่วงเฝ้าระวัง เตือนผู้ประกอบการเรือเพิ่มความระมัดระวัง วันที่ 10 ส.ค. 69 สํานักงานเจ้าท่าภูมิภาคสาขาเชียงราย เผยสถานการณ์น้ําโขงล่าสุดทรงตัวและมีแนวโน้มลดลงอย่างต่อเนื่อง หลังปริมาณน้ําทางตอนเหนือทั้งจีนและลาวเริ่มลดระดับ ยืนยันยังไม่ถึงขั้นวิกฤตและกระทบต่อบ้านเรือนประชาชน แต่ยังคงเตือนสุ่มเสี่ยงน้ําเท่อเอ่อท่วมพื้นที่เกษตร พร้อมออกประกาศเตือนการเดินเรือให้ระวังเศษไม้-กระแสน้ําเชี่ยว นายสุรนาท ศิริโชติ ผู้อํานวยการสํานักงานเจ้าท่าภูมิภาคสาขาเชียงราย เปิดเผยถึงสถานการณ์ระดับน้ําในแม่น้ําโขงว่า ระดับน้ําล่าสุดวัดได้ที่ประมาณ 7.53 เมตร ซึ่งทรงตัวและเริ่มมีแนวโน้มลดลงจากเมื่อวานนี้ จากการติดตามข้อมูลระดับน้ําทางตอนเหนือบริเวณเมืองสบกก สปป.ลาว และเมืองจิ่งหง ประเทศจีน พบว่าระดับน้ําปรับตัวลดลงแล้ว ส่งผลให้ระดับน้ําโขงในพื้นที่จังหวัดเชียงรายทยอยลดลงตามลําดับ อย่างไรก็ตาม ปริมาณน้ําโขงที่ยังสูงอยู่ได้ส่งผลกระทบทําให้เกิดภาวะน้ําเท่อบริเวณปากน้ําที่เป็นลําน้ําสาขา อาทิ น้ํารวก แม่น้ําคํา แม่น้ํากก และแม่น้ําอิง เอ่อท่วมพื้นที่ทางการเกษตร ซึ่งขณะนี้องค์กรปกครองส่วนท้องถิ่นและหน่วยงานราชการที่เกี่ยวข้องได้ลงพื้นที่สํารวจและให้ความช่วยเหลือเบื้องต้นแล้ว ทั้งนี้ ระดับน้ําดังกล่าวยังไม่ส่งผลกระทบต่อบ้านเรือนประชาชนอย่างมีนัยสําคัญ นายสุรนาท ระบุอีกว่า ระดับน้ําโขงในปัจจุบันที่ 7.53 เมตร ถือว่ายังอยู่ในช่วง “เฝ้าระวังและติดตามสถานการณ์” โดยระดับน้ําที่จะเริ่มเข้าขั้นวิกฤตจะอยู่ที่ประมาณ 8.50 เมตรขึ้นไป เนื่องจากจุดตลิ่งต่ําที่สุดในพื้นที่ จ.เชียงราย เช่น [...] Source

ph.title: Discoloration of river system in Davao Oriental raises alarm
ph.description: DAVAO CITY – The local government of Banaybanay in Davao Oriental has sought the help of the Mines and Bureau Geosciences (MGB) in Davao Region as residents suspect that the ongoing mining operations may have caused the discoloration of the river systems in the area. This developed as local residents posted pictures of the orange-colored and muddy flood water taken in Barangays Causwagan and Maputi following heavy rains last week. Banaybanay Mayor Lemuel Ian Larcia requested MGB Davao Region chief Beverly Mae Brebante to conduct an ocular inspection and appropriate assessment of the mining operations of ARC Nickel Resources, Inc. (ANRI) in Barangay Pintatagan and Zetusa in Barangay Mahayag. “This request is being made following the recent heavy rainfall and flooding experienced in the municipality, during which flood waters flowing from river systems in Barangay Causwagan and Barangay Maputi toward downstream communities have becomeThe observed condition has raised concerns regarding the possible effects of runoff, sedimentation, and other environmental impacts that may be associated with mining activities in the area” Larcia wrote on his letter addressed to the MGB Davao Region chief dated August 7. Larcia said that the on-site inspection and assessment is needed to determine the possible cause of the unusual coloration and turbidity of the floodwaters. He added the assessment could also help determine whether mining operations may have contributed to the condition. “We further request that the appropriate findings and recommendations be provided to the Municipal Government of Banaybanay for proper coordination and appropriate action. We believe that an immediate technical assessment is necessary to ensure the protection of our environment and the safety and welfare of the affected downstream communities,” the mayor further wrote. In a statement, the MGB Davao Region said that it had already deployed a technical assessment team last Saturday, August 8. The agency said that the on-site investigation will determine the root cause of the discoloration and evaluate actual field conditions. “Following the assessment, the team will evaluate environmental impacts and identify appropriate immediate actions to address the siltation,” MGB Davao Region added. Meanwhile, the local government on Friday also formed a monitoring team composed of different concerned agencies to look into the incident. Larcia said the monitoring and inspection were in response to reports and observations following the recent heavy rainfall and flooding wherein floodwaters flowing from the river in Barangay Causwagan and Barangay Maputi to the downstream communities have become unusually muddy and orange in color. “This condition is alarming as it may indicate significant soil disturbance, erosion, sediment discharge, or other environmental concerns that require immediate assessment,” he said in a directive to heads of key departments. The mayor ordered the team to conduct a comprehensive ocular inspection of the affected area and adjacent waterways. He also required them to document all observations through photographs, videos, maps, and written findings. Larcia gave the team two days to submit a written inspection report and recommendations. In January 2022, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources suspended the nickel mining operations of Riverbend Consolidated Mining Corp. and Arc Nickel Resources Inc. in Banaybanay after heavy rains caused overflow from silt ponds, discoloring the Mapagba and Pintatagan rivers. However, mining operations about a month later resumed after the firms implemented steps to address the siltation and discoloration of the rivers.

pk.title: Syria: Preparedness and Response Plan for heat waves and climate-related changes in Raqqa, Al-Hassaka, and DRZ June 2026
pk.description: Country: Syrian Arab Republic Source: Health Cluster Please refer to the attached file. Overview Heat constitutes a significant environmental and occupational health hazard. Heat stress stands as the foremost cause of weather-related fatalities and can exacerbate pre-existing medical conditions, including cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, mental health disorders, asthma, and heighten the risk of accidents and the transmission of certain infectious diseases. Heatstroke represents a medical emergency with a notably high case fatality rate. The population exposed to extreme heat is escalating exponentially due to climate change across all global regions. Heat-related mortality among individuals aged 65 and older surged by approximately 85% between the periods of 2000–2004 and 2017–2021 (1). From 2000 to 2019, studies indicate that approximately 489,000 heat-related deaths occur annually, with 45% of these fatalities occurring in Asia and 36% in Europe (2). In Europe alone, the summer of 2022 witnessed an estimated 61,672 excess deaths attributable to heat (3). Intense heatwave events can precipitate significant acute mortality; for instance, in 2003, 70,000 individuals in Europe succumbed to the June–August heatwave. Similarly, in 2010, 56,000 excess deaths were recorded during a 44-day heatwave in the Russian Federation. Vulnerability to heat is influenced by both physiological factors, such as age and health status, as well as exposure factors, including occupation and socio-economic conditions.

pk.title: Pakistan hockey team arrives in Netherlands for World Cup 2026
pk.description: Pakistan’s national hockey team has arrived in the Netherlands to compete in the FIH Men’s Hockey World Cup 2026, which is being jointly hosted by the Netherlands and Belgium from August 15 to 30. The team was warmly received at the airport by officials from the Pakistan Embassy in the Netherlands. The squad departed for the Netherlands on Sunday from Lahore’s Allama Iqbal International Airport. Before the team’s departure, the Pakistan Hockey Federation (PHF) transferred Rs20 million in foreign daily allowances to the bank accounts of the players and coaching staff. “The federation’s objective is to free the players from financial concerns and allow them to focus fully on their performance on the field,” the PHF said in a statement. According to the federation, all logistical arrangements for the team, including travel, accommodation, meals, local transportation and the transportation of sports equipment, have been completed. PHF President Mohyuddin Ahmed Wani said the welfare of the players and coaching staff remained the federation’s top priority. “All necessary financial and administrative matters have been settled transparently before departure so that the team can represent the country and nation on the global stage without any hesitation,” he said.

iq.description: شفق نيوز- بغداد قرر الاتحاد العراقي لألعاب القوى،بالتنسيق مع اللجنة الأولمبية الوطنية العراقية، يوم الاثنين، إعادة بطل رمي القرصمصطفى كاظم داغر إلى ألمانيا لاستكمال معسكره التدريبي، استعداداً للمشاركة فيدورة الألعاب الآسيوية المقبلة في مدينة ناغويا اليابانية. وقال المدير التنفيذي للاتحاد العراقيلألعاب القوى، زيدون جواد، لوكالة شفق نيوز، إن الاتحاد يواصل إعداد داغر للبطولةالآسيوية، مبيناً أن اللاعب عاد إلى بغداد وبدأ تدريباته بعد انتهاء تأشيرة دخولهإلى ألمانيا قبل نحو أسبوع. وأضاف جواد أن داغر نجح خلال معسكره التدريبيالأخير في ألمانيا في تطوير رقمه من 57 متراً إلى 60 متراً، مشيراً إلى أن الاتحادقرر إعادته إلى ألمانيا لاستكمال برنامج الإعداد التدريبي. وفي سياق متصل، أعلن جواد إضافة العداءالواعد فلاح حسن هادي إلى فريق ألعاب القوى المشارك في دورة ناغويا، بعد النتائجالتي حققها في البطولات العربية والآسيوية. وأوضح أن هادي أحرز ذهبيتي سباقي 100و200 متر في بطولة العرب، وسجل رقماً قياسياً عراقياً وعربياً في البطولة التيأقيمت بمدينة الإسماعيلية المصرية، فضلاً عن إحرازه فضية سباق 100 متر في بطولةآسيا بمدينة أوردوس الصينية. وأكد المدير التنفيذي للاتحاد أنالأرقام التي حققها هادي تؤهله للمنافسة على إحدى الميداليات في دورة الألعابالآسيوية المقبلة، رغم صغر سنه، مشيداً في الوقت ذاته بدعم رئيس اللجنة الأولمبيةالوطنية العراقية عقيل مفتن، الذي قال إنه أسهم في توفير متطلبات الإعدادوالمعسكرات التدريبية للرياضيين.
